root_cause: The HUD.init() function unconditionally creates new DOM elements with IDs that already exist in the static HTML, causing duplicate elements with the same IDs. Specifically, 'crosshair', 'hpFill', 'waveInfo', 'reloadSpinner', 'hitMarker', 'vignette' and '.ammo-pip' elements are duplicated. The updateHP function writes to 'healthFill' (created by fx_hud) instead of the static 'hpFill' that players see, and the gameOver/victory screens are also duplicated because they are created unconditionally instead of being adopted from static HTML.
